[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Lin Konpost''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. Depressed over her situation, Konpost would drink day and night at the [[The Free Access Grill|Free Access Grill]]. When she ran out of money, she would travel to the [[TGM deep mining station]] and computer stress analyses for the [[tectonic manipulation excavator]]s.
